result.stdout:
codemap - package repositories into AI-friendly output

Usage:
  codemap [options]
  codemap stdout, -s [options]   Print packed content to stdout
  codemap clipboard, -c [options] Copy packed content to clipboard

Source:
  -r, --remote <url|owner/repo> Clone a remote Git repository
  -b, --remote-branch <branch>  Branch to clone

Selection:
  -i, --include <patterns>      Comma-separated include globs
  -e, --exclude <patterns>      Comma-separated exclusion globs
  -m, --max-file-size <bytes>   Skip larger files
  -c, --config <path>            Configuration JSON file

Output:
  -f, --format <xml|markdown|json|plain>
  -o, --output <path>           Output file (default: codemap-output.md)
  -a, --apply <patch-file>      Preview, approve, and apply a Git diff
  --no-summary                  Omit summary metadata
  --no-tree                     Omit directory structure
  --split-output <bytes>        Split large output into numbered files
  -p, --patch                   Add patch-generation instructions in selected format

Transformations and limits:
  --security-check              Exclude files with DevSkim findings
  --remove-comments             Remove common source comments
  --remove-empty-lines          Remove blank lines
  --line-numbers                Add line numbers
  -t, --token-budget <count>    Fail when rendered output exceeds count

Git and workflow:
  --include-diffs               Include git diff
  --include-logs                Include recent git commits
  --include-logs-count <count>  Number of commits (default: 20)
  -w, --watch                   Report source changes
  -v, --version                 Show the tool version
  -h, --help                    Show this help

Examples:
  codemap --format markdown --output repository.md
  codemap --include "**/*.cs" --security-check
  codemap --remote microsoft/generative-ai-for-beginners --remote-branch main

More documentation: README.md
